items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Well, every Sunday you'd meet a bunch, but it'd be the same bunch like Rene, Buddy Petit

ctx.x: Who did you meet in the street, some of the different bands?

Well, every Sunday you'd meet a bunch, but it'd be the same bunch like Rene, Buddy Petit, Sam Marock, Chris Kelly, and what's his name? The Dine, downtown there, Cindy Desvinge, the old tuxedo, all them bands used to be out on the street, you know, advertising dances on Sundays. Maybe one of them would be playing at a funeral or something, somebody would die, and they'd all get on that together.
Did you ever have any battles of music in the places like, say, the Bows Club or any of those?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: And I won one from Rene. But me and Rene split even.

ctx.x: With who? I won one from Chris Kelley. That's up. Tuxedo beat me. And I won one from Rene. But me and Rene split even. I'll tell you how that come out. See my bunch gave me the cup the first time we played, and then Rene had a white bunch too you see, and they gave him the cup the next time, well he and him split even see. But I won Chris Kelley and I won one from Rene and I lose with their tuxedo. They had twelve pieces and we had six. I couldn't do nothing but lose that.
I'd really have the six myself.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: They called Rene to go up here in maybe Macomb City or Bad Nourish.

ctx.x: What kind of jobs did y'all play in those days with those different bands?

Well lawn parties was the most. They was going big, middle of the week or any time. And like maybe they called Buddy Petit to go to Bugaloosa Friday and Saturday. They called me to go to Gurpoor, Biloxi Friday and Saturday. They called Rene to go up here in maybe Macomb City or Bad Nourish. But that's how the band made their money. Every band like Saturday and Friday to go off somewhere. Sunday they had to be back here to play these economy halls and advertising and things all like that. Now all day Sunday the…
You remember any of the different guys that was playing?
